messages:
maria (support): FYI customer acme-prod is seeing intermittent 500s on /v1/generate since 09:00 PST. Error id: err-0x7a3. Also they reported tokenization auth failures with KMS error 'Access denied to key' for signed payloads. Escalating to sec & infra.

raj (eng-runtime): looking. Can you paste request_id and region? Any recent deploys?

maria (support): req 8b3f2c7a region us-west-2. We rolled a small runtime patch at 08:50 that adjusted caching/backoff. Also billing spike coincided but not sure related. Customer says audits show missing CloudTrail entries for key usage 08:52-09:05.

lisa (sec): @raj @oliver pls note pen-test item #21 mentioned alias enumeration + stale key material. Need to confirm if the kernel change touched KMS client or retry paths. Also retention config could drop logs if service account rotated.

oliver (platform): no rotation scheduled from platform side. I can pull KMS IAM bindings and CloudTrail for that window. grabbing logs now.

raj (eng-runtime): quick check: we changed long-poll backoff in runtime. Unlikely to affect KMS auth but will try to reproduce with their workload. maria can you provide sample payload (anonymized)?

maria (support): attached sanitized request payload and headers (in customer thread). Also they supplied a stacktrace snippet: "cryptokms: permission denied" and 500 with "internal/kms: auth failure".

dave (pen-tester): sharing notes from pen: during testing we observed ephemeral key alias caching that could present stale alias->key id mappings when HSM rotated. That caused 403s for some calls until cache invalidation. Could be related.

lisa (sec): if cache invalidation bug exists we need severity discussion. Customer impact = production errors + missing audit entries. I'd push to Sev2 until we confirm root cause.

raj (eng-runtime): reproducing locally with alias rotation simulation... got a 403 when alias->key mapping stale. trace: `kmsClient.GetKey(alias)` returned 404 after rotation, code didn't refresh cache for 2m. I'll open quick fix to force refresh on 404.

oliver (platform): CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt calls from serviceprincipal:infra-agent at 08:51 and then a gap 08:55-09:03 consistent with failed calls. Also see a rotation event at 08:49 from keymanager. So timeline matches.

maria (support): customer is asking for ETA and wants proof we fixed before they escalate to legal. Any temporary mitigation?

raj (eng-runtime): mitigation: rollback the caching change (hotfix) + add immediate cache invalidation on key rotation events. Pushing patch to staging, running canary.

jenkins-bot: deploy started to canary group 'acme-canary' (build 2026.3.57) — 10 instances — logs streaming.

dave (pen-tester): we should retest with alias rotation scenario and also validate CloudTrail continuity. I'll schedule a 15-min retest window.

maria (support): I told customer we'll have hotfix ETA ~30m and will share verification steps.

lisa (sec): also need to document evidence for pen findings closure: CloudTrail slices, KMS API logs, checksum of deployed binary, and repro script. @dave can you confirm acceptable artifacts?

dave (pen-tester): yes: 1) repro script + config, 2) before/after CloudTrail entries, 3) logs showing 403->200 transition, 4) signed release sha. That will close the pen item.

raj (eng-runtime): canary shows 0 500s for 12m. I see kms calls returning 200 now. Pushing full rollout.

oliver (platform): rollout complete. Invalidation hook added to event stream and we updated retention policy to ensure CloudTrail retention >90 days for customer audits.

maria (support): customer verified issue resolved and provided success logs. They accepted our remediation and asked for follow-up runbook.

lisa (sec): marking pen item #21 status: remediation applied, retest passed, evidence uploaded to secure bucket. Mark severity downgraded to Low pending postmortem.

maria (support): thanks team. Closing loop with customer and adding runbook to docs.
